findings.title: `OR` condition in `deleteMany` omits `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS` and causes a full table scan
findings.body: In `prisma.workflowReminder.deleteMany`, the second branch of `OR` is `{ retryCount: { gt: 1 } }` without `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS`. Because `WorkflowReminder` only has indexes on `(method, scheduled, scheduledDate)` and `(cancelled, scheduledDate)` and no index on `retryCount`, an `OR` with an unindexed `retryCount` predicate forces PostgreSQL to scan the entire `WorkflowReminder` table on every cron run (and will also delete non-SMS reminders if any ever use `retryCount`). Keeping `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS` at the top level of `where` (or adding `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS, scheduled: false` to the second branch so it uses the `(method, scheduled, scheduledDate)` index) scopes the delete to SMS reminders and allows index usage.
